The Covid Physical Therapy website and Covid Physical Therapy YouTube Channel were created as resources for those who are no longer critically ill but who are still recovering and may not have access to rehabilitation services or high quality guidance. All the information provided here is evidence-based and as up to date as possible. We hope it helps on your road to recovery.

For additional information, resources and handouts, please see the companion website: https://www.covidphysicaltherapy.org

DISCLAIMER:
The videos and information provided through www.covidphysicaltherapy.org and the Covid Physical Therapy YouTube Channel are not medical advice or a treatment plan. They are intended for general education and demonstration purposes only and should not be used to self-diagnose or self-treat any health, medical or physical condition.
